Package neqsim.process.measurementdevice

Class ConeFlowMeter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.util.NamedBaseClass
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.MeasurementDeviceBaseClass
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.StreamMeasurementDeviceBaseClass
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.DifferentialPressureFlowMeter
neqsim.process.measurementdevice.ConeFlowMeter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, TransientStateParticipant<DifferentialPressureFlowMeter.DifferentialPressureFlowMeterState>, MeasurementDeviceInterface, ProcessElementInterface, NamedInterface
public class ConeFlowMeter extends DifferentialPressureFlowMeter
Cone-meter differential-pressure flow meter following ISO 5167-1 and ISO 5167-5.

The cone meter has no physical throat bore: a cone of diameter dc is mounted concentrically in a pipe of diameter D, and the diameter ratio is derived from the annular flow area around the cone, ISO 5167-5 Formula (2): 

 beta = sqrt(1 - dc ^ 2 / D ^ 2)

Set the geometry with setGeometry(double, double, String), passing the cone diameter as the second argument; the equivalent throat diameter d = D beta is derived and stored exactly as for the other differential-pressure devices.

Within its limits of use (50 mm <= D <= 500 mm, 0.45 <= beta <= 0.75, 8.0e4 <= Re,D <= 1.2e7) an uncalibrated cone meter has a constant discharge coefficient C = 0.82 (ISO 5167-5), independent of the Reynolds number and the pipe diameter. The expansibility factor is ExpansibilityModel.CONE, ISO 5167-5 Formula (4): 

 epsilon = 1 - (0.649 + 0.696 beta^4) * dP / (kappa * p1)
